alate: Body deep brown, wing membrane pale greyish white. Head capsule subcircular, the coronal suture faintly discernible. Fontanelle pale and depressed, with several longitudinal striae arranged in three parallel lines in front of it. The long diameter of the compound eye about 4–5 times its distance to the lower margin of the head, the long diameter of the ocellus about 4 times the distance between the ocellus and the compound eye. The distance from the ocellus to the antennal socket about 3 times the distance from the compound eye to the antennal socket. Lacinia of the maxilla with 9 marginal bristles. The cubitus of the forewing and hindwing with about 17 branches.
soldier: Head deep yellowish brown, pronotum slightly paler, abdomen pale yellow. Head capsule subrectangular, the sides slightly widened posteriorly. Fontanelle slightly projecting. Labrum semicircular. Mandibles sabre-shaped, the apices slightly curved. Lacinia of the maxilla with 9 marginal bristles. The antennae are all broken off, segment 1 slightly larger than segment 3, segment 3 about twice segment 2. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a broad V-shaped notch, the lateral margins sloping steeply backwards, the posterior margin slightly concave at the centre, the median longitudinal line visible, the median area with about 20 hairs.
